responses.text: You hear about that band of crazy old ladies running around? I hear they're real vicious when they mug folks.
If the Lucky 38 coulda been giving us power all along, why all the fuss with Hoover Dam?
Try sleeping with that Lucky 38 all lit up above you. Just try.
Your lady friend needs to lighten up.
Good to see Rex still around and kicking.
That's one ragged Ghoul you've got with you. Seems like a good guy, though.
Odd company you keep. I thought all Super mutants were crazed cannibals.
Weird robot. I don't think I've ever seen one of those before.
Check out the Wrangler if she needs booze.
Keep your guns to yourself and there won't be any trouble.
You're not doing yourself a favor by having him tag along. NCR aren't welcome here.
I'm surprised to see Arcade venturing out of the Old Mormon Fort. I thought science types preferred to stay indoors.
Howdy.
Hey.
One of these days you'll get what's coming to you.
Eat shit and die. That clear enough for you?
{Annoyed}We don't take kindly to your type around these parts.
{Annoyed}Leave me alone, scumbag.
{Annoyed}You're a real piece of work.
{Annoyed}Great. You again?
You're one crazy bastard, you know that?
I can't decide if I should shake your hand or make a run for it.
Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapons, eh?
Decisions are hard, aren't they?
We're all hoping you'll eventually figure out which side you're on.
Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapon.
Thanks for everything you've done. It really means a lot.
I hope some of the thugs around here follow your shining example.
You've been a godsend to Freeside.
Thanks for helping out around here.
Good to see you're still around.
Hey, good to see you.
Hmm?
Yeah?
What's up?
I wish I were there to see you take Benny down.
Well, it looks like we won't have to worry about NCR or the Legion messing with us now. I just hope the Securitrons can keep the peace.
Can't say I like all the tin cans shuffling around, but this new Securitron Army shouldn't have much trouble keeping things safer around here.
Why not just put the slave collars on us yourself, you bastard. With the Legion at the dam, it won't be long before they enslave us all.
I heard the Legion is bringing in giant mutant dogs to assault the dam. I hope the NCR death squads packed steaks to distract them.
Don't be fooled. As soon as the Legion and NCR start fighting, the robots will invade and kill us all!
I hope the Legion gets destroyed. If they take the dam, we'll all be slaves.
Normally, I'd say screw the NCR, but if the Legion takes the dam, I think we're all screwed.
It looks like the Legion might be preparing for another run at the dam. This can't be good.
Well, aren't you just special? Everybody likes the new guy, but me? I'm chopped liver.
I hear you're building quite the reputation on The Strip. Don't forget about the little guys when you make it big.
That new Ranger armor is downright impressive. I'd hate to be on the business end of one of their revolvers.
I've been hearing rumors of the Rangers getting some heavy reinforcements soon. Hope they don't try to start anything around here.
Good news for Freeside. The Kings have decided to work with NCR for a change.
I don't get why the Kings are dead. They weren't a bad bunch of guys.
I heard the Khans went wild at Hoover Dam. I suppose they were looking for one last blaze of glory.
People say the Khans got wiped out at Red Rock. That's one less bunch of crazies to worry about.
The Great Khans moved out? One less mob of degenerates to worry about, if you ask me.
So, the Great Khans signed up with NCR. Who would have thought those two would settle their differences?
Those sick Legion bastards had the brass balls to attack Bitter Springs? I bet that was one messy fight.
Maybe it'll be a little safer to travel, now that the Fiends' bosses are dead. We owe their killer a debt of gratitude.
I heard Motor Runner got taken down. Maybe the Fiends will finally destroy themselves now that he's gone.
Hanlon was apparently sabotaging NCR's efforts in the area. Now, I kind of wish he hadn't died.
Chief Hanlon is dead? I hear that guy couldn't order himself out of a cardboard box, let alone command troops
My friends say Kimball's assassination was all an Illuminati plot to reclaim power. I say they're crazy. How do you kill someone with a flashlight?
Kimball getting killed is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
Killing Kimball is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
So, I hear that assassination attempt on Kimball didn't quite turn out the way you planned. Now, the NCR are going to be even pissier than usual.
I suppose you did the right thing saving Kimball, even though it means we're still screwed here in Freeside.
You freed that Silus guy from McCarran? Guess you've got your reasons for helping the Legion.
I guess the monorail getting bombed wasn't all bad. Freeside is getting a lot more business now.
With the monorail down, we're going to have a lot more NCR goons wandering through here. Yay...
Never thought I'd see House settle for being an NCR lapdog. What the hell happened?
People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.
All hail the slayer of Caesar! It's about time that slavemaster got his!
I don't need to read no obituary to know House was an asshole.
With no House to boss Vegas around, the NCR's gonna want that job.
House dead? Good riddance.
Better give the Securitrons a wide berth if you know what's good for you. Those new upgrades look nasty.
House must have special plans for you to get into the Lucky 38 and come out alive.
I hear you made a real mess of the Omerta's plans. Hopefully, the new management does a better job running Gomorrah.
Impressive work fighting off Benny's thugs! I know I wouldn't have survived that.
Figures that Benny would run. Sorry coward's nobody without his thugs to back him.
Later.
See {ya}you.
Bye.
Bye.
Hey, good going with that hit on The Tops.
That prick, Benny, had it coming.
I always suspected Benny was a coward.
You must have some serious brass to fight off Benny's goons. Bravo.
You made a real mess of the Omertas. Looks like the place will be under new management now.
You must have some real pull with House to get inside the Lucky 38.
Have you seen the new Securitron upgrades? I pity anyone who gets testy with those bots now.
The Lucky 38 has been quiet. I wonder if something happened to House.
Have you noticed the Securitrons acting up? People are saying House might be dead.
Hey, you're the one who slayed Caesar! That son of a bitch had it coming!
People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.
Good going destroying House's Securitron Army. That old boy's had too much power for too long.
Great, with the monorail bombed, Freeside is the only route in and out of Vegas.
At least the local vendors are seeing more business with these wealthy NCR shits wandering through.
I hear some Legionary named Silus got freed from McCarran. He's got quite the NCR kill count.
Why didn't you just let Kimball get killed? What did he ever do for us to warrant saving his life?
You must have thought you were hot shit going after Kimball like that, huh?
I hear you bagged kimball. Damn fine work, kid.
Some President Kimball was. Chalk up another death to NCR incompetence.
Good riddance. With Chief Hanlon dead, that's one less officer to lead the NCR troops.
Too bad Hanlon is dead. It turns out he was trying to get the NCR out of the Mojave.
The Fiends have been less organized with Motor Runner gone. Good riddance.
Shouldn't be long before the Fiends are wiped out, now that their bosses are gone.
Did you hear? The Legion attacked Bitter Springs!
Did you hear the Khans signed a treaty with NCR? I wonder how that happened.
People say the Khans got wiped out at Red Rock. That's one less bunch of crazies to worry about.
The Great Khans moved out. One less mob of degenerates to worry about, if you ask me.
Crazy Khan bastards. What were they thinking attacking the dam like that?
With the Kings gone, Freeside is going to be a real mess.
The Kings are working with NCR? What's this place coming to?
People are talking, buddy. You've made quite an impression on The Strip.
The Rangers are getting reinforcements? I hope they don't decide to bring the battle to Freeside.
Things look to be building up on either side of the dam. This doesn't look good.
The legion is bad enough. The last thing we needed around here is even tougher NCR Ranger thugs coming along.
It looks like the Legion and NCR are getting ready for a fight. I hope that doesn't end badly for us.
I hope the NCR have the manpower to defend the dam. It looks like the Legion are going to attack soon.
Without you, we'd all be slaves. Thanks for helping the NCR at the dam.
As if House didn't have enough control already. At least we don't have to deal with NCR or the Legion, now.
Hello there.
How's it going?
Howdy.
Hey.
Good day.
Yep.
Howdy, Arcade.
{Grunt}Another NCR grunt.
Good to see another strong-willed woman around.
That is one odd robot.
A Super mutant in Freeside?
That has to be the oldest Ghoul I've ever seen.
What's up Rex?
What's your problem, lady?
